prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: C01-CH04-S19 龙眠共同逃生. One NEW finished opaque full-bleed narrative game illustration, wide 16:9 landscape, preferably native 1672×941. Entire complete authored scene with no border or writing.
Input roles: Image1 supplies APPROVED broad chunky matte game style, stout exaggerated proportions, large expressive heads/hands, confident dark outlines. Image2 is APPROVED YOUNG IVRA exact identity: copper red dragon, slate gray throat/belly panels, dark gray dorsal spine, amber eye, swept ivory gray horns, red-brown wing membranes with a few healed nicks, small pale old neck scar, strong but lean youth anatomy. Image3 is APPROVED age22 LEIA exact identity: warm face, large brown eyes, brown single braid, narrow low simple headband, dark bluegray cape, gray segmented armor, old left wrist guard. Do NOT copy her flagpole or ledger into this scene. Image4 is approved wide scene handling and clear silhouettes only; do not copy forge content.
Story authority: Ivra is a free autonomous equal ally. It has received and destroyed the coercive true-name interface. Church control spikes now shatter the snowy Dragon-Sleep mountain. The normal descent is cut off. Ivra voluntarily lets Leia onto its bare back so BOTH can cross the collapse and reach the final spike. Leia first removes hooked shoulder armor and all metal that could hurt the wing roots. She follows Ivra's bodily bank instead of directing it. This is an urgent shared escape and physical cooperation, not a queen taming a dragon, ownership, permanent cavalry mastery or a reward ceremony.
Single decisive moment: the young red dragon is airborne just after leaving a collapsing snow-covered rock ledge, banking toward a surviving ridge across a deep cleft. Leia is crouched low astride the dragon's bare upper back just behind the neck, between but CLEAR of the wing roots. Her torso leans with the dragon's tilt, face anxious and concentrated into the wind. Her two hands are open and braced lightly on broad back scales for balance, never gripping horns, reins or throat. Her bent knees rest loosely against its sides, with no straps. Her bluegray cape and single braid trail back in the wind. Her headband is the narrow simple band from reference, NOT a tall crown. Smooth gray torso armor remains, but sharp shoulder armor and hooked protrusions are absent; her upper shoulders have plain dark cloth and a small old left-shoulder bandage. No flag, sword or ledger in her hands. Her full face, both hands and clear seated/crouched body must be readable.
Dragon anatomy and framing: Ivra is the largest central subject, a strong young quadrupedal dragon with FOUR compact legs tucked naturally beneath the body and TWO clearly separate wings. Entire head, both swept horns, both wings including tips, four limbs/claws, and long tail ALL fit inside the image with at least80px safe margins. No clipped wingtip, cropped tail or missing limb. Wide wings are partially flexed in a dynamic natural bank rather than fully horizontal wingspan. Body runs diagonally lower-left to upper-right, head near x58% y47%, Leia near x46% y33%, tail curls back inward to x25% y70%; wings span approximately x18% to x83%, high tips near y15%, leaving clear sky around them. Show body side/belly enough to distinguish four legs; maintain exact young red/gray identity rather than a pale adult dragon. Amber eye looks ahead toward the escape route, wary and determined, mouth closed or slightly open from effort; no smile, no breath attack. Simplify skin into broad chunky red planes, a few large shoulder scales only, no fine scale lattice.
Setting: cold daylight high in a snowy mountain cleft. Behind and below left, a broad slab of rock and snow has just fractured away; several LARGE angular rock chunks fall into the abyss with two simple snow-plume shapes. The opened gap visibly explains emergency flight. A broken dark metal control-spike fragment is embedded on the distant abandoned ledge, inactive and small. A surviving broad ridge lies ahead to the right; distant mountains are large pale blue-gray triangular masses. Omit armies and spectators. Sky is pale cold blue, broad dark stone planes and clean white snow accent the warm red dragon. Central interaction is clear against uncluttered sky and distant cool shapes. The action should feel urgent and cooperative, not a posed heroic victory. No gigantic debris field, no tiny pebbles or sparkling snow carpet.
Style/medium: match approved chunky matte tactical-fantasy cartoon. Strong clean dark outlines, larger expressive heads and hands, broad solid painted surfaces, only2–3 shade values per form, simplified rock faces, minimal grain. Clear small-size reading at256×144. The dragon and Leia remain whole in the full wide frame; full composition takes priority over narrow portrait crop.
Hard constraints: deliberately opaque full scene. NO saddle, harness, collar, bridle, rein, leash, chains or decorative armor on Ivra. No human holding a neck ring or horns, no crown, no dragon-rider command gesture, no weapon raised, no victory flag, no cheering crowd, no giant adult gray dragon, no mounted royal throne, no angel/glitter/golden divine rays, no neon magic, no flames, no text, lettering, symbols, UI, frame, watermark. No photorealism, glossy3D, fine etched scales, stippled textures, grainy surfaces, over-detailed debris or gloomy monochrome. Preserve physical rescue contact; do not put Leia separately on the ground or flying unaided. Legacy source slot contains the wrong generic giant dragon/army and is archived only; story authority and approved identities supersede it.
